name: steady hands
did: A pad button that nobody is pressing is no longer treated as a press. A worn shoulder or a resting trigger used to board barricades by walking up to them and start the round before you had chosen a character; the engine now refuses any button until it has seen it released once. Auto repair is gone entirely -- boarding a window is holding the use key and nothing else.
onAccept: Your round is saved and the map is rebuilt. You keep your points, your guns and your perks, and the dead hold off for three minutes while you get set.
